segments.ja: リベリオの広場が巨人の戦いになっているとき、別の翼が夜の空から降ります。降りるのは、島の調査兵団です。調査兵団の刃は、マーレの砲と巨人の両方を相手にします。相手の中心は、まだエレンです。エレンは戦鎚と、顎と、遅れて来た鎧のあいだにいます。いる場所へ、ミカサが先に速度を合わせます。合わせる降下が、この強襲の始まりです。降りる翼の数を、ジャンは着地の前に一度数えます。
segments.en: While Liberio's square has become a fight of Titans, different wings fall from the night sky. What falls is the Survey Corps of the island. The Survey Corps' blades take both Marley's cannon and the Titans as opponents. The center of the opponents is still Eren. Eren is between the war hammer, the Jaw, and the Armor that came late. Mikasa matches her speed to that place first. The descent she matches is the start of this assault. Jean counts the number of descending wings once before landing.

segments.ja: ジャンは、降りた屋根から客席の残骸を見ます。見る残骸は、数時間前まで祭りの席でした。席の上に、今は巨人の足跡があります。ある足跡のあいだを、住民がまだ走っています。走っている人を、彼は敵の町の人として切りません。切らない判断が、強襲の難しさです。難しさのまま、彼は班の位置を呼びます。呼ぶ声に、コニーが返事をします。
segments.en: From a roof he landed on, Jean looks at the remains of the seats. The remains he looks at were festival seats a few hours ago. Titan footprints are now on the seats. Between the footprints that are there, residents are still running. He does not cut the people who are running as people of an enemy town. The judgment of not cutting is the difficulty of the assault. Still in the difficulty, he calls the squad's positions. Connie answers the voice that calls.

segments.ja: ミカサは、戦鎚の白い武器の軌道を避けてエレンの側面へ入ります。入る目的は、顎のポルコを一度引き離すことです。引き離す刃は、四年ぶりに同じ巨人の隣で振るわれます。振るう相手は、島の敵だった顔をまだ内側に持っています。持っていることを、彼女は今日は呼びません。呼ばない集中で、彼女はエレンの消耗した拳を支えます。支える位置が、強襲の核です。
segments.en: Mikasa avoids the path of the war hammer's white weapon and enters Eren's flank. The purpose of entering is to pull Porco's Jaw away once. The blade that pulls it away is swung beside the same Titan for the first time in four years. The opponent she swings at still holds, inside, a face that was an enemy of the island. She does not call that today. With the concentration of not calling, she supports Eren's exhausted fist. The position of supporting is the core of the assault.

The eyes that watch do not speak the brother's name long today. The distance of not speaking remains between the two. The thrown stones silence the cannon at the edge of the square first.

segments.en: Gabi has not let go of the gun she picked up behind the rubble. The aim she has not let go of is the winged soldiers who came down. She thinks those soldiers are devils of the island. The bullet she thinks with has not been fired yet. The reason it has not been fired is that Falco makes her lower the muzzle once. The shout that makes her lower it is that people are still running. In the square where they are running, her anger keeps looking for a target. The eyes that keep looking are the preparation of a later shot.

Hange measures the short time with signals from the ground. The signal she measures is not yet a retreat. It is not. It is the margin until they catch the real body.

segments.en: Reiner's Armor is split from receiving both Eren's fist and the war hammer. Even with split joints, he does not move from the center of the square. The reason he does not move is that the internment zone is still behind him. He has not been able to protect the town that is there completely. Porco looks at the back that has not protected it, as if clicking his tongue. The Jaw that looks still turns its teeth toward the same enemy. The joint fight he turns is not friendship. It is not. It is a posting that delays the town being trampled.

segments.en: Armin has not immediately brought out the Colossal form in this assault. The reason he has not is that it would burn the harbor and the residents at one time. The work of that kind decides where the wings land. From the position he decides, Mikasa looks again at Eren's exhaustion. The exhaustion she looks at is the shake of the fist searching for the war hammer's thread. The power held back is a judgment meant to spare the harbor's fire.

segments.en: Magath is still giving orders from a collapsed command post. The orders he is giving are to draw the Titans outside the square. The cannon that draws them is carried on Pieck's Cart. The cannon that is carried went silent once under the Survey Corps' descent. After the silence, he divides the streets with the guns that remain. The purpose of dividing is to stretch the time of surrounding Eren. The time he stretches runs out before the war hammer's real body is found. In the square where it ran out, the assault enters the next stage.

segments.ja: ファルコは、強襲の翼を悪魔とは呼び切りません。呼び切らない理由は、自分が部屋へ運んだ人がこの穴を開けた、です。開けた罪悪と、ガビの姿を失った恐怖が同時にあります。ある両方で、彼は瓦礫の名前を呼びます。呼ぶ声は、巨人の足音に負けます。負けるあいだも、彼は銃をガビから離そうとします。離そうとする手が、今日の彼の戦いです。戦いは、点数ではありません。
segments.en: Falco does not fully call the wings of the assault devils. The reason he does not fully call them that is that the person he carried to the room opened this hole. The guilt of opening it and the fear of having lost Gabi's figure are there at the same time. With both that are there, he calls names in the rubble. The voice that calls loses to the Titans' footsteps. Even while it loses, he tries to move the gun away from Gabi. The hand that tries to move it is his fight today. The fight is not points.

segments.ja: ハンジの観測と、エレンの拳が、硬化の糸の根に近づきます。近づく地面が、不自然に硬く光ります。光る場所を、ミカサが上から指します。指す一点が、戦鎚の人が隠れた殻かもしれません。かもしれません、を、強襲は確かめる時間をほとんど持ちません。持たない理由は、鎧と顎が同時に戻ってくる、です。戻ってくる妨害のあいだに、エレンは拳をその光へ落とします。落とす音が、広場の次の割れ目です。
segments.en: Hange's watching and Eren's fist come near the root of the hardening thread. The ground that comes near shines hard, unnaturally. Mikasa points from above at the place that shines. The one point she points at may be the shell where the war hammer's person hid. The assault has almost no time to confirm the may. The reason it does not have time is that the Armor and the Jaw come back at the same time. Between the interference that comes back, Eren drops his fist onto that light. The sound of the drop is the square's next crack.

segments.titleEn: The retreat signal is not yet
segments.ja: オニャンコポンは、飛行船の位置を風に合わせて保ちます。保つ耳は、地上の最終信号を待っています。待っている信号は、まだ来ていません。来ていないあいだ、兵は広場から離れられません。離れられない強襲は、成功と遭難の境にいます。境を、ジャンは仲間の残数で測ります。測る数が、降りる前より少ないことを彼は知っています。知っている顔で、彼は次の屋根へ飛びます。信号が来ないあいだ、船上の灯は低く保たれます。
segments.en: Onyankopon holds the airship's position to the wind. The ear that holds it is waiting for the final signal from the ground. The signal he is waiting for has not come yet. While it has not come, the soldiers cannot leave the square. The assault that cannot leave is on the border of success and disaster. Jean measures the border by how many companions remain. He knows the number he measures is smaller than before they descended. With the face that knows it, he flies to the next roof. While the signal does not come, the lamps aboard are kept low.

segments.en: This assault ended Marley's festival and, at the same time, made the internment zone a battlefield. The purpose of dividing is to stretch the time of surrounding Eren. The time he stretches runs out before the war hammer's real body is found. In the square where it ran out, the assault enters the next stage.

vocab.exampleJa: 持たない理由は、鎧と顎が同時に戻ってくる、です。
vocab.exampleEn: Hange's watching and Eren's fist come near the root of the hardening thread. The ground that comes near shines hard, unnaturally. Mikasa points from above at the place that shines. The one point she points at may be the shell where the war hammer's person hid. The assault has almost no time to confirm the may. The reason it does not have time is that the Armor and the Jaw come back at the same time. Between the interference that comes back, Eren drops his fist onto that light. The sound of the drop is the square's next crack.

vocab.exampleJa: 戻ってくる妨害のあいだに、エレンは拳をその光へ落とします。
vocab.exampleEn: Hange's watching and Eren's fist come near the root of the hardening thread. The ground that comes near shines hard, unnaturally. Mikasa points from above at the place that shines. The one point she points at may be the shell where the war hammer's person hid. The assault has almost no time to confirm the may. The reason it does not have time is that the Armor and the Jaw come back at the same time. Between the interference that comes back, Eren drops his fist onto that light. The sound of the drop is the square's next crack.

vocab.exampleJa: 来ていないあいだ、兵は広場から離れられません。
vocab.exampleEn: Onyankopon holds the airship's position to the wind. The ear that holds it is waiting for the final signal from the ground. The signal he is waiting for has not come yet. While it has not come, the soldiers cannot leave the square. The assault that cannot leave is on the border of success and disaster. Jean measures the border by how many companions remain. He knows the number he measures is smaller than before they descended. With the face that knows it, he flies to the next roof. While the signal does not come, the lamps aboard are kept low.

vocab.exampleJa: ことになる力を、ハンジは最後の札に残しています。
vocab.exampleEn: Armin has not immediately brought out the Colossal form in this assault. The reason he has not is that it would burn the harbor and the residents at one time. Hange is keeping the power that would do that as the last card. While she keeps it, he guides from the ground. The voice that guides is the same kind as the night of the depot diagram. The work of that kind decides where the wings land. From the position he decides, Mikasa looks again at Eren's exhaustion. The exhaustion she looks at is the shake of the fist searching for the war hammer's thread. The power held back is a judgment meant to spare the harbor's fire.

vocab.exampleJa: 見る目は、兄弟の名を今日は長く話しません。
vocab.exampleEn: From outside the square, the Beast Titan appears in a throwing posture. The one who appears is Zeke. Zeke's stones break Marley's cannon soldiers first. The alliance of that breaking is still under-explained to the island's soldiers. Still under-explained, his throwing becomes one wing of the assault. Levi watches that wing with eyes that know it. The eyes that watch do not speak the brother's name long today. The distance of not speaking remains between the two. The thrown stones silence the cannon at the edge of the square first.
